body: Reggie admits that he posts and rants a lot online during all of these allegations, but his reasoning behind it is that he considers himself a “retired streamer” who is currently unemployed and just “chilling” while still making money… “I don’t got nothing else to do all day so I post” Reggie continues to post stories every single day, taking aiming individually at more and more people Is he doing this all on purpose? kaicenat cloverboys.
